interactions.note: The epitope of BD-813 Fab on the SARS-CoV-2 S6P(B.1.351) protein was determined from the cryo-EM structure of BD-813 and BD-744 Fabs in complex with the prefusion-state-stabilized S trimer an overall resolution of 3.2 Å. The S-HexaPro (S6P) variant of the S protein, which has a stabilized prefusion structure because of the introduction of six proline substitutions in the S2 segment, was used. Additional mutations (L18F, D80A, Δ242-244, D215G, K417N, E484K, N501Y, D614G, and A701V) were introduced into the S6P construct using site-directed mutagenesis to generate S6P(B.1.351).
